name: controlled-v3-development
description: Development compatibility corpus for target-inspection and backend preflight. These cases were inspected while extending parser support and are not a held-out performance set.

definition.label: circomlib Decoder vulnerable
definition.input_assumptions: inp is a canonical BN128 field element. Decoder(4) is defined for every field element; no narrower caller precondition is imposed.

known_defects.location: circuits/multiplexer.circom:80-94; witness-only output selection permits out[i]=0 when inp=i
known_defects.local_reproduction: Exact vulnerable source and Decoder(4) wrapper compile under the frozen development environment; backend discovery is not established by this annotation.
known_defects.reachability: The public metadata's original entrypoint is the same direct wrapper; a larger project caller is not established.

structure.size_source: Circom R1CS compiler summary: non-linear constraints + linear constraints under recorded compile settings
limitations: Complexity counts only IfThenElse and While nodes in the named root template definition, not reachable dependency templates.
AST control-flow nodes are not expanded for concrete parameters, loop iterations, or Circom constraint optimizations.
num_statements counts visited AST statement nodes, including blocks; it is not source lines or constraints.
R1CS constraint count is a separate concrete compiled size measure, not LEOPARD structural complexity.
zkFuzz --show_stats_of_ast exits after parse/type analysis; this invocation provides no fuzzing or defect-reproduction evidence.

features.meaning: single-arrow assignment has a quadratic RHS that could instead use a constraint assignment; separate constraints can still make it correct
analyzer could not establish the required input range for a Circomlib LessThan use
analyzer did not find its supported IsZero-based nonzero check for the divisor
intermediate signal appears in fewer than two separate constraints under this analyzer's analysis
instantiated component output is not used as expected, subject to the analyzer's allowlist and access approximation

unsupported_features.reason: the verified Circomspect release has no dedicated rule that establishes this distinction; assertions are not counted
